classification: preregistered retrospective falsification test on a fresh sample window; not prospective, not confirmation of any prior result, and not a rescue of any falsified mechanism
objective: Falsify or fail-to-falsify whether trailing funding persistence predicts continuation of the long-carry funding premium on a fresh sample window disjoint from every previously tested sample.

hypothesis.mechanism: Funding-rate persistence: funding rates are serially persistent at the 8h cadence. A long cash-and-carry position (long spot, short perpetual) entered after observing 18 consecutive positive funding events, using only past funding data, earns positive net funding premium over the subsequent 240 hours (10 funding events) in the preregistered holdout window.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Positive per-cycle net carry after 2x reported taker costs; no directional price-return claim.
hypothesis.not_claimed: No claim that this is unconditional carry; no claim of any CAGR target; no claim of portability beyond this mechanism.
hypothesis.mechanism_selector: persistent-positive-count equals 18 out of the last 18 events (parameter fixed before outcome access; not searched).

rule.signal: At each 8h funding boundary t with event index i, compute pos_count as the number of strictly positive signed funding rates among the previous 18 funding events, i.e., events i-17..i inclusive. All 18 events must be strictly positive; the event at i itself must also be strictly positive and is included in the count.
rule.entry: When pos_count == 18, enter a long spot + short perpetual 1x-gross cash-and-carry pair at the next available 1h bar open. That bar open time must be strictly greater than the funding event calc_time that completed the 18-event sequence, and within 2 hours of it; otherwise the entry is skipped and counted.
rule.exit: Exit at the 1h bar open 240 hours after entry (not the close), or earlier only on the preregistered hard liquidation gate. A profitability threshold never triggers an early exit.
rule.hard_liquidation_gate: This contract posits no margin/liquidation modeling beyond gross exposure: exit early only if either leg would violate the cash floor >= 0, using the same-hour adverse extreme bound (perp HIGH for the short leg; spot LOW for the long leg); the early unwind books realized extras at those same adverse prices, exactly as in the audited carry engine.
rule.funding: Signed funding on the short perp leg accrues at each 8h exchange boundary strictly after entry and at-or-before exit, using the frozen funding file. Negative rates stay negative.
rule.gross_exposure: Gross NAV exposure is exactly 1.0x at entry (long spot 0.5x, short perp 0.5x) and may drift only through price motion; no hidden cross-margin credit; cash floor >= 0 at every audited hour.
rule.cooldown: No re-entry while a position is open per asset. Re-entry is permitted at any later 8h boundary meeting the 18/18 rule, including immediately after a prior position exits.
rule.no_lookahead: All signal inputs are from strictly before the entry bar time. Gate metrics use only the entry bar to exit bar price and funding paths available in the frozen sample.

cost_model.cost_application: Both legs pay their fee at entry and at exit (2x per entry/exit per leg); forced unwinds pay the same rate on the unwound leg(s).
cost_model.funding_accrual_location: At 8h event boundaries inside the holding period, exactly as recorded in the frozen funding files.

sample.fresh_data_disjointness: 2024-07..2024-12 and 2025-01..2025-06 are untouched by every prior tested mechanism: funding-crowding (2020-08..2024-12), carry and corrected-audit (2020-08..2024-12 + retrospective 2025 diagnostic), basis-convergence (2020..2024 validation), microstructure (bounded recent sample), and all focused-campaign screens (2026-08 live).

primary_falsification_gates.spec: With exactly 18/18 trailing positive funding events required, the pooled mean per-entry net return fraction (after all contract costs) over all holdout signal entries must be strictly > 0.
With the same entry rule, the pooled median per-entry net return fraction over all holdout signal entries must be strictly > 0.

what_would_falsify.minima_unmet: If either holdout minimum is unmet, the sample is inconclusive rather than falsified.
what_would_falsify.mean_or_median_nonpositive: If pooled holdout entries meet both minima and the pooled mean or pooled median net fraction is <= 0, the mechanism is falsified for this sample.
what_would_falsify.tail_breach: If the single worst per-entry net fraction is <= -0.10, the mechanism is rejected as unstable regardless of the mean/median outcome.

positive_gate_rule: The mechanism passes this sample only if both primary gates pass on minima-met pooled entries and no what_would_falsify rule triggers. A pass triggers exactly one preregistered replication run on the preregistered second window.

replication_contract.data_precondition: Second-window funding and hourly bar files must exist for both assets before a replication attempt; otherwise the status is blocked-no-second-sample-data, not a pass or a fail.
replication_contract.single_post_outcome_replication: At most one replication run. Its gates are identical to the primary gates. A replication failure records replication-failed; it cannot be retried on a third window.

claim_boundary: This contract does not authorize deployment, account access, live orders, or capital allocation. A pass is a sample-conditional result, not durable-alpha proof. No pooling with prior mechanisms, no threshold tuning, no re-running on previously tested samples, no search over the persistence count (18 and 21 are both frozen), and no additional windows beyond the single preregistered replication.

data_sources.funding_archives: quant-trading/data/raw/binance/funding-rate/{asset}/{asset}-fundingRate-YYYY-MM.zip with columns calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate (calc_time in ms).
data_sources.spot_and_perp_bars: quant-trading/data/raw/binance/{spot-1h,um-perp-1h}/{asset}/{asset}-1h-YYYY-MM.zip; 2020-08..2024-12 bars use ms open_time, 2025+ bars use us open_time; both are normalized to UTC ms.
data_sources.checksum_binding: Every consumed archive must pass its upstream .CHECKSUM SHA-256 file check before use.

adapter_semantics.record_shape: Historical Binance CSV rows, not capture JSONL. Dedup identity is (source_file, row_index); no dedup_id wrapper exists or is simulated.
adapter_semantics.immutable_prefix_equivalence: Full monthly archive bytes are consumed only after SHA-256 verification; there is no partial-prefix truncation and no live-tail hazard.
adapter_semantics.clock_mapping: Signal timestamps are funding-file calc_time (exchange-authored, ms). Bar open/close timestamps are exchange-authored open_time/close_time (ms pre-2025, us from 2025), normalized to UTC ms; close_time is open_time + interval - 1 unit for boundary math.
adapter_semantics.earliest_stop_equivalence: No live deadline exists. The earliest-stop rule is replaced by the frozen sample end boundary passed to the runner, which no bar used by a gate may exceed.
adapter_semantics.event_ordering: Rows are sorted by exchange time; within the same exchange timestamp, funding boundaries precede 1h bar opens.
adapter_semantics.gap_handling: A missing 1h bar at a scheduled entry/exit boundary skips that boundary and counts the skip; funding never accrues on a bar that does not exist.

selection_policy: Both variants are computed on the development window for feasibility and direction context. The primary holdout verdict uses only the predeclared 18/18 rule. The 21/21 variant is a robustness diagnostic on the same holdout and cannot replace, rescind, or upgrade the 18/18 verdict.
dev_consent_gate: If the 18/18 rule yields zero entries in the development window, the run stops with blocked-no-dev-sample and the holdout is not accessed, pending a new preregistered contract.
